sidebar.reachabilityBar: Share of devices that answered recently

header.noAlerts: No alerts. Notifications are not connected to this console yet.

connection.label: Control plane
connection.degradedBody: Requests still get through, but the live channel is down. Figures change only when a page refreshes them.
connection.offlineBody: Nothing is getting through. What is on screen is the last answer this console received, not the state of the mesh.

routeError.title: This page could not be drawn
routeError.body: The console kept running. The rest of it is still usable, and the navigation on the left still works.
routeError.appTitle: The console could not be drawn
routeError.appBody: The failure happened above every page, so there is nothing left to show but this.
routeError.errorIdHint: Quote this identifier when reporting the failure. The console prints the full error to the browser console and shows nothing more here.

notFound.title: No such page
notFound.body: This address does not belong to the console. It may have been renamed, or the link may be wrong.

narrow.title: Use a wider window
narrow.body: The admin console needs a window at least 1024 pixels wide. On a phone you can manage your own devices from your personal space.

login.title: NeroNet Enterprise
login.subtitle: NeroNet network management console
login.failed: Sign-in failed. Check your username and password and try again. If it keeps happening, tell an administrator.
login.method: Sign-in with a password and a protected session

mfa.prompt: Enter the 6-digit code shown by the verification app on your phone.
mfa.useRecovery: No phone? Use a recovery code
mfa.recoveryPrompt: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works only once.
mfa.enrolIntro: This account needs a second code. On your phone, open a verification app (for example Google Authenticator), scan the QR code below, then type the 6-digit code that the app shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code to scan with the verification app
mfa.secretLabel: If you cannot scan it, type this code into the app:
mfa.recoveryIntro: These are your recovery codes. Save them now somewhere safe: they will not be shown again. You need them if you lose your phone; each code works only once.
mfa.enrolSubmit: Confirm the code and sign in
mfa.failed: That code did not work. Check the six digits and try again.

login.unreachable: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

wipe.title: Delete your account and its devices?
wipe.body: Your account and every device registered to it are deleted now. This cannot be undone.
